items.title: New commission to provide insight as OpenAI builds the world’s best-equipped nonprofit
items.summary: Already a nonprofit, and already using AI to help people solve hard problems, OpenAI aims to build the best-equipped nonprofit the world has ever seen—combining potentially historic financial resources with something even more powerful: technology that can scale human ingenuity itself.
items.summaryZh: 新委员会将在 OpenAI 打造世界上装备最精良的非营利组织之际提供见解。OpenAI 已经是一家非营利组织，并且已经利用人工智能帮助人们解决难题，其目标是打造世界上有史以来装备最精良的非营利组织——将潜在的历史性财务资源与更强大的东西相结合：能够扩展人类创造力本身的技术。

items.title: PaperBench: Evaluating AI’s Ability to Replicate AI Research
